workflow: William Henry Gates (Bill Gates) is an American business magnate, investor, author, philanthropist, and humanitarian. He is best known as the co-founder of Microsoft Corporation, the world’s largest personal-computer software company. Throughout his career, Gates has held the positions of chairman, CEO, and chief software architect at Microsoft, and was the largest individual shareholder until May 2014.
